title: Planning Git access
responsibility: Provide repository reads and validate artifact paths and local Git LFS image content.

inputs.name: planGit.root
inputs.description: Exact repository root; a nested directory is refused.

inputs.name: revision.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: revision.value
inputs.description: Branch, tag or commit; defaults to HEAD and rejects empty, option-like or newline-containing values.

inputs.name: paths.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: paths.path
inputs.description: Optional repository path filter; defaults to the whole tree.

inputs.name: blob.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: imageBlob.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: safePath.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: safePath.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative path to check for unsafe segments or existing symbolic links.

inputs.name: containing.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: containing.rev
inputs.description: Revision at which to inspect path history.

inputs.name: containing.path
inputs.description: Artifact path whose first creation commit is needed.

outputs.name: planGit
outputs.description: Repository handle using the canonical root, Git directory and known object format, with a command runner.

outputs.name: paths
outputs.description: Matching paths from the revision tree.

outputs.name: blob
outputs.description: Blob bytes for an existing regular-file entry.

outputs.name: imageBlob
outputs.description: Local Git LFS content after pointer, length and SHA-256 verification.

outputs.name: safePath
outputs.description: Returns nothing when the path has safe segments and no existing symbolic-link component.

outputs.name: containing
outputs.description: Oldest creation commit found for the path within the selected history.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Reports invalid repositories or revisions, missing/tampered artifacts, unsafe paths and failed Git commands.
